task.title: Regenerating a robot account token by using the Red Hat Quay API
task.shortdesc: To replace a compromised or outdated robot account credential, you can regenerate a robot account token by using the Red Hat Quay API for organization or user robots.

ul.li: You have created an OAuth access token.
